sources.title: Visa-free countries for Cape Verde
sources.publisher: Portal Único do Governo de Cabo Verde
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Portal Único entry is hosted on the Cabo Verde government gov.cv domain and is filed under Visas and Borders.
sources.supportingExcerpt: countries whose citizens are exempt from a visa for Cabo Verde

sources.title: Countries requiring a visa for Cabo Verde
sources.publisher: Portal Único do Governo de Cabo Verde
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Portal Único entry is hosted on the Cabo Verde government gov.cv domain and is filed under Visas and Borders.
sources.supportingExcerpt: must obtain a visa before entering Cabo Verde

sources.title: Visas
sources.publisher: Cabo Verde Ministry of Foreign Affairs consular portal
sources.officialityEvidence: The current portal is hosted on portalconsular.mnec.gov.cv, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs consular subdomain, and publishes visa categories and EASE/TSA instructions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Todos os cidadãos estrangeiros ... estão obrigados a um pré-registo

sources.title: Frequently asked questions
sources.publisher: Cabo Verde Ministry of Foreign Affairs consular portal
sources.officialityEvidence: The live FAQ is on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs consular portal and links the traveller pre-registration directly to www.ease.gov.cv.
sources.supportingExcerpt: visando um processo de verificação prévia de segurança dos viajantes

sources.title: EASE traveller pre-registration
sources.officialityEvidence: The Ministry consular portal and FAQ directly send travellers to this EASE service; its landing page provides traveller pre-registration and displays Cabo Verde and police identifiers.

sources.title: Extract of Order No. 244/GMAI/2025
sources.publisher: Boletim Oficial da República de Cabo Verde
sources.officialityEvidence: The current 24 November 2025 order is published in Cabo Verde's official gazette on boe.incv.cv.
sources.supportingExcerpt: lista de países sujeitos a visto prévio de entrada

unresolved.reason: The current Portal Único exemption and compulsory-prior-visa pages do not list this nationality. The compulsory page expressly directs an unlisted traveller to the nearest embassy or consular post; generic online, exceptional in-country and residence-based frontier routes do not establish an ordinary-passport nationality outcome. EASE pre-registration/TSA are security and airport-charge formalities, not a demonstrated pre-travel approval for this nationality. The fallback status remains unverified.
